versions.changelog: Limit list API calls to per_page=1 to avoid rate limits

Full FIT capture: per-second records table, device inventory, HR/power zone thresholds, session FTP/altitude/grade/temp/zones, lap HR and trigger. Auto-reparse on upgrade fills new data from cached FIT files.
Reclaim latest tag: functionally identical to 0.1.5/0.1.6, supersedes 0.1.4
Re-publish laps feature as latest (0.1.4 from another agent clobbered the latest tag on 0.1.5)
Add lap splits: per-lap power/HR/cadence/zone data extracted from FIT files into new laps SQLite table
Handle Ctrl+C gracefully: fetch_workouts.py now exits cleanly on keyboard interrupt instead of showing a traceback. Rate-limit sleep message now shows (Ctrl+C to abort).
